findings.title: Per-role Semaphore(1) serializes within-role traffic per API worker process
findings.detail: live_warm_worker_slots() returns {} because every live role is tier=hot while the function filters tier=='warm' -> get_role_max_concurrency()==1 for ALL roles -> primitives._acquire_role wraps every llm_call in threading.Semaphore(1). Within-role concurrency in production exists ONLY via the 6 uvicorn worker processes (each with its own semaphore + CAB, made disjoint by cross-process region flocks). On a --workers 1 API every role serializes fully: the first 4-wide burst attempt landed 4/4 on port 8082 back-to-back (staircase latencies 19.7/34.9/49.6/64.1s).
consequences: single-worker windows (J2/J3-style probes, debug shapes) cannot exercise within-role concurrency
eval fan-out concurrency is process-spread, not role-limit; E5 current-arm baseline must model it as such
the 2026-07-21 J2/J3 committed migrations (forward=6/reverse=4) are consistent with fully serial traffic (full-idle KV handovers), not overlap-driven displacement
